title: Dental PPO Plans Earlier-Coverage Months on Reprocessed Grace-Period Lines
content:
**Clause.** On a Dental PPO Plans line reprocessed after a not-eligible denial made during a premium grace period (a reprocessed grace-period line), the months credited toward its waiting period follow the person's earlier coverage, and so decide the patient share on such a line.

| | Condition | Months credited |
|---|---|---|
| (i) | The plan credits prior coverage month for month, and the person (matched by name and date of birth) has a terminated Cascade enrollment in the Prepaid Dental HMO Plans that ended on the day before the Dental PPO enrollment's coverage effective date (a move from the DHMO with no break in coverage) | The calendar months from the month that DHMO coverage took effect through the month it ended, both months counted; DHMO coverage always takes effect on the first of a month |
| (ii) | The plan credits prior coverage month for month, no such DHMO enrollment exists, and the enrollment shows documented prior coverage months whose prior coverage end date is no more than 63 calendar days before the coverage effective date | Those documented months |
| (iii) | Otherwise | None |

The months credited shorten the waiting period, never below zero. Month-for-month plans: Value 1000, Classic 1250, Plus 1500, Premier 2000 and Elite 2500; Preventive 750 credits none. The 63-day gap applies on every plan.

**Questions.**
*Does a DHMO enrollment that ended two weeks before the Dental PPO coverage began count under (i)?* No; only one that ended on the day before the coverage effective date.
*Documented coverage ended exactly 63 days before the coverage effective date, and there is no such DHMO enrollment?* The documented months are credited under (ii); at 64 days they are not.
